**Limitations**

- The gradient and hysteresis steps are our simplified version, not the adaptive gradient of the paper.
- The ISEF has a sharp peak, so it keeps more noise than a Gaussian of the same width.

**Artifacts**

- Gaps at the corners of shapes with high thresholds.
- Short spurs from noise with low thresholds.
